intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.7.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 14.66 MB fat-LTO binary, 26.95ms cold boot -76.3%, 19.57 MB RSS, Monetization Tier Presets & 48h Comeback Retention Curve Designer, Unified Pre-Publish Gate + Auto-Fix cards, 17 pre-gzipped UI chunks, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, and Rojo .zip export at 7,566 req/s), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.4.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with keyboard-first triage j/k/o/p/1-5, Worktree changed-file links via git status -z + Open file in Aux Pane, live /api/swarm/stream SSE push + Pin #seq, Context Pressure bars, and zero-dep Element.animate diet giving 406.4 KB raw / 120 KB gz, 109.5 MB RSS -10.8%, 1,324 req/s 16w pinned, 17.2ms p95, and 22/22 fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.17.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 11.76 MB fat-LTO binary, 26.19 MB RSS -49.9% vs v0.11.0, 1-Click Run/Receipt Comparison & Delta Client Pack .md, Unified Fuzzy Cmd+K jump, clickable [file:L##] Source Inspector, Promote to Playbook, Pre-Flight Check, and 5,420 req/s 16w pinned at 3.94ms p95).
